paras: Lygodactylus pauliani is a species of gecko, a lizard in the family Gekkonidae. The species is endemic to Madagascar.
The specific name, pauliani, is in honor of French entomologist Renaud Paulian.
Lygodactylus pauliani is found in southeastern Madagascar. The holotype was collected at an elevation of 1,100 m (3,600 ft).
The natural habitats of Lygodactylus pauliani are forest, grassland, rocky areas, and shrubland.
